scientific_integrity: An analytical proof supports the exact count and angular weak limit. Finite contour and product tests are explicitly non-certifying corroboration. Earlier existence, construction and bilateral summation results are credited.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed 0<a<r<1 and all sufficiently large integers m, the count concerns only zeros within |s|<r; outer-boundary zeros, effective thresholds, variable a or r, convergence rates and multi-step weights are not classified. Historical priority is provisional; no independent validation is claimed.
title: Circle condensation and exact bulk zero counts for two-step Bergman weights
